omitted.label: Acetabulum
omitted.reason: Socket cavity itself has no surface vertex at its center; preserve source diagram identification rather than placing an ambiguous rim pin.

omitted.label: Fovea of femoral head
omitted.reason: The small foveal surface depression is not reliably resolved in the decoded reduced core mesh.

omitted.label: Adductor tubercle
omitted.reason: Small prominence is not reliably separable from adjacent medial epicondyle on the reduced mesh.

omitted.label: Trochanteric fossa, intertrochanteric line/crest, linea aspera
omitted.reason: Ridges and fossae need a closer shaded-surface review before precise pin placement; source diagram coverage is safer for this pass.

omitted.label: Soleal line and intercondylar eminence of tibia
omitted.reason: Low-resolution surface detail prevents a confident local pin.

omitted.label: Greater/lesser sciatic notches, obturator foramen and acetabular notch
omitted.reason: These are not solid surface structures; a surface vertex would misleadingly identify an edge as the entire space.

omitted.label: Talar/calcaneal grooves, facets and fibular trochlea
omitted.reason: Subregions are too small to place confidently from these projections.

lower.limitation: Approximate educational pins anchored on real bone vertices. These are schematic markers, not scanned or separately segmented landmarks. Pending integrated visual QA; no marker should be marketed as a realistic anatomical surface.
